technique_name: Write the biography of a famous person.
description: Kobe Bryant is one of the greatest basketball players of all time, having enjoyed a storied 20-year career with the Los Angeles Lakers. He was an 18-time All-Star, 15-time member of the All-NBA Team, 12-time member of the All-Defensive team, and the 2008 NBA Most Valuable Player. He won five NBA championships and has achieved numerous records and accolades in his illustrious career.
